path.description: A JSON Pointer path to a value in the state

Action.description: Declarative event action. When the event fires, the declared action mutates state.

action.description: The action to perform when the event fires.

path.description: JSON Pointer path to the state key to update.

value.description: The value to write into the state path.

SlotNode.description: Slot binding: Reference to a specific child node.

items.description: The unique identifier for a child component node. Do not reuse the same component id in multiple parents or multiple children positions.

StaticChildren.description: A static list of child component IDs. Every id in this array must be unique and must not be reused by any other parent node. Create a separate child node for each rendered position.

onClose.description: Fires when the drawer requests to close. Typically a setState that writes false to the same path bound to `open`.

width.description: Drawer width. Number is px, string is CSS size. Only for left/right placement.

footer.description: Footer content. Omit this prop when no footer is needed.

className.description: Tailwind CSS classes for the component.
